questions.title: 직원 환영 이메일
questions.passage:
Dear Team,

I am pleased to announce that Ms. Jennifer Park will be joining our marketing department as Senior Marketing Analyst ______(1) Monday, March 10.

Ms. Park brings over eight years of experience in digital marketing and data analytics. She previously worked at GlobalTech, where she was ______(2) for leading a team of 15 analysts.

Please make sure to introduce yourselves and help her ______(3) to our office environment. ______(4)

Best regards,
David Kim
Director of Marketing

blanks.explanation: 특정 요일(Monday) 앞에는 전치사 'on'을 사용합니다.
blanks.tip: 'on + 요일/날짜'는 토익의 단골 출제 포인트!

blanks.explanation: 'be responsible for'는 '~에 대해 책임이 있다'라는 고정 표현입니다. 형용사 'responsible'이 필요합니다.
blanks.tip: be + ______ + for 패턴 → 형용사 자리!

blanks.explanation: 'help + 목적어 + 동사원형'은 '~가 ~하는 것을 돕다'라는 의미입니다.
blanks.tip: help + 사람 + 동사원형(또는 to부정사). 'help her adjust'가 정답!

choices: A welcome lunch will be held in the conference room at noon on her first day.
Ms. Park graduated from Seoul National University with honors.
The marketing budget for this quarter has been finalized.
Please submit your timesheets by the end of the week.
blanks.explanation: 문맥상 새 직원 환영과 관련된 내용이 와야 합니다. 첫날 환영 오찬 안내가 가장 적절합니다.
blanks.tip: Part 6 문장 삽입: 앞뒤 문맥의 흐름(환영 → 환영 행사)을 따라가세요!

questions.title: 사무실 이전 공지
questions.passage:
NOTICE TO ALL EMPLOYEES

Effective April 1, Nextera Solutions will be ______(1) to a new office location at 250 Harbor Drive, Suite 400.

All employees are required to pack their personal belongings by March 28. Boxes and packing materials will be ______(2) by the facilities team starting March 20.

During the transition period, remote work will be permitted from March 29 through April 2. ______(3) Please ensure that your laptops and necessary files are prepared ______(4) for working from home.

For questions, contact the Facilities Department at ext. 3200.

blanks.explanation: 'will be relocating'은 미래진행형으로 예정된 이전 과정을 나타냅니다.
blanks.tip: will be + ~ing = 미래진행형. '이전하는 중일 것이다'라는 진행의 뉘앙스!

blanks.explanation: 'will be distributed'는 미래수동태입니다. 박스가 '배포되는' 것이므로 수동태가 적절합니다.
blanks.tip: will be + p.p. = 미래수동태. 주어(Boxes)가 '배포당하는' 입장!

choices: Normal office operations will resume on April 3.
Lunch will be provided in the cafeteria.
Annual performance reviews are due next month.
blanks.explanation: 재택근무 기간(3/29~4/2) 언급 후, 정상 업무 재개일(4/3)을 안내하는 것이 자연스럽습니다.
blanks.tip: 시간 순서를 따라가세요: 재택근무 기간 → 정상 복귀일!

blanks.explanation: 'in advance'는 '미리, 사전에'라는 의미입니다. 재택근무 전에 미리 준비하라는 맥락입니다.
blanks.tip: in advance = 미리! '사전에 준비해두세요'라는 흐름.

questions.title: 신제품 출시 기사
questions.passage:
TechVision Inc. announced yesterday that it will launch its ______(1) smartphone model, the Vision X10, on June 15.

The new device features a significantly improved camera system and a battery that lasts up to 30% longer than ______(2) of previous models. According to CEO Sarah Chen, the company has invested over $200 million in research and development to ensure the product meets the ______(3) standards of today's consumers.

______(4) Pre-orders will begin on May 20 through the company's official website and authorized retailers.

blanks.explanation: 'latest'는 '최신의'라는 형용사입니다. 명사(smartphone model) 앞에서 수식합니다.
blanks.tip: late의 변형: late(늦은) → later(나중의) → latest(최신의). 명사 앞 = 형용사!

blanks.explanation: 'that'은 앞에 나온 단수명사 'a battery'를 대신합니다. 'that of previous models' = 이전 모델의 배터리.
blanks.tip: that/those = 앞의 명사 반복 대신! 단수면 that, 복수면 those.

blanks.explanation: 'demanding'은 '까다로운, 요구가 많은'이라는 형용사로 'standards'를 수식합니다.
blanks.tip: demanding standards = 까다로운 기준. ~ing 형용사는 '~한 특성을 가진'!

choices: Industry analysts predict the Vision X10 will be the top-selling device of the year.
TechVision was established in Silicon Valley in 2010.
The company's stock price has fluctuated over the past month.
Employee satisfaction surveys will be conducted next quarter.
blanks.explanation: 신제품의 시장 전망 → 사전 주문 안내로 이어지는 흐름이 자연스럽습니다.
blanks.tip: 제품 소개 → 전문가 전망 → 구매 방법 = 자연스러운 기사 흐름!

questions.title: 연수 프로그램 안내
questions.passage:
MEMORANDUM

To: All Department Managers
From: Human Resources
Subject: Mandatory Training Program

As part of our ongoing commitment to professional development, all managers are ______(1) to complete the new Leadership Excellence Program by September 30.

The program ______(2) of six online modules and two in-person workshops. Each module takes approximately 90 minutes to complete and can be accessed through the company's learning management system.

______(3) Managers who fail to complete the program by the deadline may not be ______(4) for the annual performance bonus.

Please contact HR at training@nextera.com for assistance.

blanks.explanation: 'are required to'는 '~해야 한다'는 수동태 표현입니다.
blanks.tip: be required to + 동사원형 = ~할 것이 요구되다 = ~해야 한다!

blanks.explanation: 'consist of'는 '~으로 구성되다'라는 의미입니다. 주어 'The program'이 3인칭 단수이므로 'consists'.
blanks.tip: consist of = ~으로 구성되다. 주어가 단수(The program)이므로 consists!

choices: Schedules for the in-person workshops will be announced by August 1.
The company picnic is scheduled for next Saturday.
New employees should report to the front desk on their first day.
The quarterly budget report is due by the end of this month.
blanks.explanation: 프로그램 구성 설명 후, 대면 워크숍 일정 안내가 이어지는 것이 자연스럽습니다.
blanks.tip: 온라인 모듈 설명 → 대면 워크숍 일정 → 미이수 시 불이익 = 논리적 순서!

blanks.explanation: 'be eligible for'는 '~의 자격이 있다'라는 고정 표현입니다. 형용사 'eligible'이 필요합니다.
blanks.tip: be eligible for = ~의 자격이 있다. be 동사 뒤 = 형용사 자리!

questions.title: 고객 사과 서한
questions.passage:
Dear Mr. Thompson,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the delayed delivery of your order #45892. Due to an ______(1) high volume of orders during the holiday season, our warehouse experienced significant processing delays.

Your package was shipped on January 8 and is ______(2) to arrive by January 12. You can track your shipment using the tracking number provided in the confirmation email.

As a token of our appreciation for your patience, we would like to offer you a 20% discount on your next purchase. ______(3)

We value your continued ______(4) and look forward to serving you again.

Sincerely,
Customer Service Team
QuickShop Online

blanks.explanation: 'unexpectedly'는 부사로 형용사 'high'를 수식합니다. '예상치 못하게 높은 주문량'.
blanks.tip: _____ + 형용사(high) → 부사 자리! unexpectedly = 예상치 못하게.

blanks.explanation: 'is expected to'는 '~할 것으로 예상된다'라는 수동태 표현입니다.
blanks.tip: be expected to = ~할 것으로 예상되다. 토익 빈출 수동태 표현!

choices: The discount code THANKYOU20 has been applied to your account and is valid for 60 days.
Our warehouse is located in Chicago, Illinois.
We are currently hiring seasonal workers for our distribution center.
The product you ordered has received excellent reviews from other customers.
blanks.explanation: 20% 할인 제안 후, 구체적인 할인 코드와 사용 기간을 안내하는 것이 자연스럽습니다.
blanks.tip: 할인 제안 → 할인 코드 상세 안내 → 감사 인사 = 논리적 흐름!

blanks.explanation: 'patronage'는 '후원, 애용'이라는 명사입니다. 'continued patronage' = 지속적인 애용/이용.
blanks.tip: patron(후원자) + age = patronage(후원, 애용). 비즈니스 서한 마무리 단골 표현!
